comment: The rate of skipped display slots (checks.pacing.max_late_frac) is the one pacing number that depends on the machine; the other pacing checks (no stall, cadence, no hitch, steady latency, vsync) are the same everywhere. On this rig e2e_openxr_probe (1800 frames) measured 2.46 % and 2.52 % in two runs, all of it made before the encoder (the same 2.5 % at the host's send): the app or the boundary pick had nothing ready for that slot. It measured about 0 % on 2026-10-08/09, before the Oct 10 pacing redesign. The ceiling is twice today's value: a regression on this rig still fails. client_p99_ms and intake_p99_ms are the one-skipped-slot values (22 ms) with margin.
